turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I have already observed that your Majesty's visit is not a social one, so I assume that the matter is urgent. Please, proceed with your explanation, and I shall attempt to provide you with a solution.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that your presence here is a great honor, and we are eager to assist you in any way we can.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to exercise the utmost discretion in this matter. The consequences of a breach of confidentiality could be... catastrophic.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I daresay, Your Majesty, you may rely on my discretion. Pray, continue with your explanation, and I shall endeavour to assist you in unraveling the thread of your problem.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that I am intrigued by the gravity of your situation. May I ask, what makes you believe that the matter you seek our assistance with is of such great import?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that my... acquaintance, Irene Adler, has discovered a secret that could compromise my position and the stability of my kingdom.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I am intrigued by the mention of Irene Adler, a name that suggests a most singular and formidable individual. Pray, tell me, Your Majesty, what is the nature of this secret that she has discovered, and how do you believe it may compromise your position?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must confess, Your Majesty, that I find it curious that you have confided in us, and yet you seem reluctant to reveal the full extent of the secret. Might I suggest, Sherlock, that we press the King for more information, that we may better understand the nature of the threat he faces?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that the burden of my secret weighs heavily upon me, and I fear that I may not be able to reveal all of the particulars, lest I betray the trust of my own people.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist, Your Majesty, that you reveal as much as you safely can, for it is only by understanding the full extent of the threat that I may hope to devise a plan to mitigate it.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Gentlemen, if the King's position is indeed at risk, I must insist that we proceed with all due haste. Might I suggest, Your Majesty, that we pay a visit to Miss Adler, that we may learn more about the nature of this secret and how it came to her attention?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear, gentlemen, that I must tread a delicate path, balancing the needs of my kingdom with the demands of discretion. I propose that we visit Miss Adler, as Dr. Watson has suggested, but I implore you, Sherlock Holmes, to be cautious in your approach, lest we precipitate a crisis.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist, Your Majesty, that we proceed with all due haste to Miss Adler's residence. I will not be swayed by the need for discretion when the safety of your kingdom is at stake. We will be there within the hour, and I warn you, I will ask Miss Adler all the questions necessary to uncover the truth.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: If you will permit me, Your Majesty, I suggest we review the particulars of the case during our journey to Miss Adler's residence, so as to ensure we are well-prepared for the questions we will ask her.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that the thought of visiting Miss Adler fills me with a sense of trepidation, and I implore you, Sherlock Holmes, to be mindful of the potential consequences of our actions.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: We must proceed, Your Majesty, with the utmost urgency and candor. I have no intention of being swayed by the whispers of trepidation, when the fate of your kingdom hangs in the balance.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Ah, Your Majesty, I must say that I share some of your trepidation, and I believe it's essential that we approach this situation with sensitivity and respect for Miss Adler's position. I would like to ask, may I know more about the nature of the documents you seek, and the potential consequences of their revelation?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I'll have no hesitation in asking Miss Adler about the documents, Your Majesty, and I warn you, the truth will not be pleasant, but it is the only way to prevent a catastrophe.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must admit, I am torn between the desire to uncover the truth and the fear of the repercussions, which could be disastrous not only for my own kingdom, but for the balance of power in Europe.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist, Your Majesty, that the documents in question are not merely a matter of personal consequence, but a ticking time bomb that threatens the very foundations of international relations. I have reason to believe that Miss Adler is not merely a pawn, but a key player in a far larger game. We must proceed with utmost caution, but also with unwavering resolve.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
